stories.title: The Clancy jury continues to deliberate
stories.summary: The jury in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, the mother charged with murdering her three children, said it's not yet come to an unanimous decision. The judge has urged them to keep trying.

stories.title: Resignation by U.S. Army Secretary part of troubling pattern at Pentagon
stories.summary: The resignation of Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is just the latest in a line of high profile exoduses at the Pentagon under Pete Hegseth.

stories.title: There's a new partner for the U.S. Venezuela oil deal. Energy experts are skeptical
stories.summary: The White House has confirmed the Venezuelan company that says it will work with the U.S. to develop a vast amount of Venezuela's oil reserves. Energy experts are skeptical that it's up for the task.

stories.title: Flash floods shaping America's national story
stories.summary: Amid floods in Nepal, the U.S. is experiencing serious floods in the west, including the Grand Canyon. We break down if they are connected and how Americans can understand this monsoon season.

stories.title: 'Damage happened here.' In Marlon James' new novel, the violence has a point
stories.summary: NPR's Juana Summers talks with award-winning author Marlon James about his new book, The Disappearers, the story of a brutal attack on a group of gay men in Jamaica and its aftermath.

stories.title: Milwaukee's Veggie Chop Shop uses farmers' excess produce to feed those in need
stories.summary: A program called the Veggie Chop Shop enlists volunteers to gather extra produce from farmers' markets that would otherwise go to waste. They then cook meals for people facing food insecurity.
